_comment: Status thresholds and publication rules, calibrated on the server's snapshots (narra calibrate --window 60m --hours 168: 160k snapshots, 2036 ticks, 2501 clusters). HOT = the top decile of a window's ETH inflow with at least nine launches; graduations no longer required (they are rare on Pons v2 and lagged the money). sprayer_max_tokens: a wallet that buys more distinct tokens than this per window is a bot and does not vote in clustering or verdicts.
